verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only BugSnag's automatic grouping: events are grouped by error class, file and line of the top in-project stack frame, and the grouping reason is shown on the error view. Nothing in the pack documents manually merging errors or splitting (unlinking) errors the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed. The error-status-and-actions excerpts mention filters and keyboard shortcuts but no merge or split action, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
